name: Process Outbox Pending
description: Manual or scheduled processing of pending Outbox messages through a publisher, with result status updates.

files.description: Loads pending messages, calls the publisher, and updates message status.
Exposes Start, Stop, and Flush for Outbox processing.
Configures cron or interval scheduling, pending message limit, and publisher.
Defines the publisher contract and console adapter.
Defines pending message loading and Outbox status updates.
